body:
## Pull request overview

This PR introduces dual-format QuickFilters support across the ObjectUI stack by adding a union type that accepts both Spec `{ field, operator, value }` and ObjectUI `{ id, label, filters[] }` formats, plus a shared normalization utility used by the spec bridge and ListView.

**Changes:**
- Added `SpecQuickFilterItem`, `ObjectUIQuickFilterItem`, and `QuickFilterItem` union type; updated `quickFilters` schema typing to accept the union.
- Added `normalizeQuickFilter(s)` utility in `@object-ui/core` and used it in the spec bridge and ListView (removing inline normalization / casts).
- Added unit + integration tests covering spec/objectUI/mixed quickFilters behavior; updated roadmap entry.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 10 out of 10 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Defines dual-format QuickFilter types and updates `quickFilters` fields to use the union type. |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Re-exports the new QuickFilter types from `@object-ui/types`. |
| packages/core/src/utils/normalize-quick-filter.ts | Adds shared adapter utility to normalize spec quickFilters into ObjectUI format. |
| packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/normalize-quick-filter.test.ts | Unit tests for operator mapping, label/id generation, and passthrough behavior. |
| packages/core/src/index.ts | Re-exports the normalize utility from the `@object-ui/core` entrypoint. |
| packages/react/src/spec-bridge/bridges/list-view.ts | Normalizes `quickFilters` during spec → SchemaNode transformation. |
| packages/react/src/spec-bridge/__tests__/P1SpecBridge.test.ts | Bridge-level tests asserting normalization and passthrough behavior. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx | Uses shared normalization utility and expands operator mapping for shorthand operators. |
| packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx | Integration tests for spec/objectUI/mixed quickFilters rendering and shorthand operators. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks the P1 QuickFilters reconciliation work as completed with more detail. |
</details>

`quickFilters` is now typed as `QuickFilterItem[]` (union includes spec items without `id`), but this component still derives `activeQuickFilters` defaults from `schema.quickFilters` and accesses `qf.id` directly (see initialization around line 345). That will fail `tsc` (and can break at runtime for spec-format items). Consider deriving defaults from the normalized list (or calling `normalizeQuickFilters(schema.quickFilters)` inside the state initializer) so every entry is guaranteed to have an `id` before it’s used.

`quickFilters` is now documented/typed as supporting both ObjectUI and spec formats, but the corresponding Zod validator still only accepts the ObjectUI shape `{ id, label, filters }` (see `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` around the `quickFilters` schema). This means spec-format quickFilters will be rejected anywhere `ListViewSchema.safeParse` / runtime validation is used. The Zod schema should be updated to accept the union (or preprocess/normalize) to match the new TypeScript types and runtime behavior.
